scope: Replacement standard-MIPS assignment implementation, levels A/B/C

modes.pipeline: B, four NOPs after each instruction; branch/jump labels relocated
modes.hazard: C, no scheduling; EX/MEM and MEM/WB forwarding plus load-use stall

method.comparisons: All 32 architectural registers and every one of 1,024 data words against a Python interpreter of encoded instructions
method.completion: Every oracle case must reach its completion PC and write reserved completion register r29
method.timing: PC must hold on each reported stall; directed load-use cases require exactly one stall; selected no-load hazards require zero stalls
method.default_rom: Additional joint smoke test uses unmodified built-in ROM in all three modes, compares all registers and all data words, and checks second reset clears PC/registers while preserving memory
